faq.question: What is CRC certification?
faq.answer: CRC stands for Certified Risk Adjustment Coder, focused on coding for chronic conditions and risk-adjusted payment models like HCC.

faq.answer: CPC covers all-round coding, while CRC focuses specifically on risk-adjustment coding like HCC, RxHCC, and CDPS.

faq.answer: HCC models, ICD-10-CM coding, CMS risk adjustment, documentation guidelines, and compliance.
